verdict.rationale: dlt documents a broad, actively maintained connector catalog: verified sources for REST APIs (generic rest_api source plus OpenAPI-spec generator for any API), SQL databases across many dialects (Postgres, MySQL, Oracle, MSSQL, BigQuery, Snowflake, etc.), filesystem/cloud storage (S3, GCS, Azure, SFTP), and destination-side connectors including vector stores like LanceDB, with docs claiming 8000+/11,200+ source connectors maintained by the dlt team and community. Migration case studies (Fivetran/HubSpot) and dbt-runner integration reinforce real-world coverage. Missing for 10: independent (non-vendor) verification of the full connector count/maintenance cadence, and a concrete enumerated list of named SaaS connectors beyond generic REST/SQL/file categories.
